نستذمي (form X)
# نَسْتَذْمِي (nastaḏmī) /nas.tað.miː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# نَسْتَذْمِيَ (nastaḏmiya) /nas.tað.mi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
